- **Not set up:** I created no scheduled job. June's request is a 17:30 weekday post, and I can't confirm that a job would post into this Slack channel.
- **Unverified claim:** My first reply said I had no scheduler. My correction said the scheduling tool "can't post into this Slack workspace." I didn't test that. The scheduler does have delivery targets, so it may be possible. Both messages should be read as "not set up," not as a confirmed limit.
- **Current offer:** June can ask me in the channel at the end of the day, and I'll post the "Pod end of day" note then. I haven't checked whether the scheduler could do this automatically.

If you want the automatic post, someone with admin access to the scheduler should confirm a delivery target for #strategic-pod, and I can create the job after that.
